rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for cutting food or another object into slices.

example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 di1 ping4 gwo2 cit3 pin3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a thin, broad slice or piece.

example.english: This slice of watermelon is very sweet.
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 sai1 gwaa1 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this for one sector-shaped serving of pizza rather than a generic thin slice.

example.english: I want a slice of pizza.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 gin6 bok6 beng2

rows.note: Use this for cutting or slashing with a knife in a drawing motion rather than neatly making slices.

example.english: Be careful—you might slice your hand.
example.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 laai1 can1 zek3 sau2
